samples.question: The image shows three filled colored regions on a white background: one red, one green, and one blue. Each region is a closed area of the same size. A pair of regions is ADJACENT when their boundaries meet, meaning their filled areas touch (the two regions share a boundary). The other two pairs are separated by a clear white gap. Exactly one pair of the three regions is adjacent. Which one pair of regions is adjacent (shares a boundary)? Answer with exactly one of red-blue, red-green, or green-blue.
